pair_rule: the two flights of a pair run back to back in the listed order
rng: draw(label, i) = int(SHA-256('<layouts_canonical_sha256>:<label>:<i>')), big-endian; Fisher-Yates from the end, j = draw(label, i) mod (i + 1)
selection: the analysis plan's pilot rule selects the 200- or 250-pair schedule before the first confirmatory flight; nothing is added, removed or reordered afterwards
